MACRS uses the General Depreciation System rates in IRS Publication 946, Table A-1 (half-year convention). It ignores salvage value and does not include Section 179 or bonus depreciation. If more than 40% of the property you placed in service during the year came in the last three months, the mid-quarter convention applies instead.
